title: ammi majus subsp. intermedium
intro: Ammi majus subsp. intermedium, commonly known as Wild Celery, is a flowering plant in the carrot family that is native to Europe and Western Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Wild Celery include its ability to act as a diuretic, reduce fever, and ease respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Wild Celery include coumarins, flavonoids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
